lines.text: &fThe server-wide market. Anything you list here is visible to every player online, which makes it the best place to move something quickly.
&7Browse the list, pick a listing, and buy it. The price is in Starcoins and is paid the moment you confirm. What you bought goes to your &fcollection&7, not straight into your inventory.
&7Press &fCreate&7 to open the listing form. Your inventory appears while the form is open so you can pick the item to sell, then set your asking price.
&7Price it against what is already listed. A listing well above the going rate simply sits there.
&7Where your purchases arrive and where an expired or cancelled listing returns to. &cCheck it&7 &8- items wait for you there and are not delivered on their own.
&8Selling to a specific player instead? A vending block does that, and does not take a listing slot.
